category: speech-to-text, text-to-speech and LLM gateway API, one-time signup credit

free_tier.stated: USD 50 in free credits at signup, no credit card required; one-time, not a monthly allowance. The credit is spent at the per-model rates: Universal-3.5 Pro pre-recorded USD 0.21 per hour, Universal-2 pre-recorded USD 0.15 per hour, Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime streaming USD 0.45 per hour, text-to-speech USD 15 per 1M characters. Free-tier streaming concurrency is 5 new streams per minute against 100 for pay-as-you-go.
free_tier.notes: models on the pricing page: speech-to-text universal-3-5-pro, universal-2, universal-3-6-pro (streaming), universal-streaming-english and universal-streaming-multilingual; text-to-speech AssemblyAI-TTS-1; an LLM gateway that lists OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Qwen models at per-token rates. unverified: whether the signup credit also pays for the LLM gateway and the text-to-speech endpoint, because the page states the credit once and names no product scope; unverified: whether the credit expires

interface_detail: REST at https://api.assemblyai.com (upload, transcript submit and poll); streaming over WebSocket at wss://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws; Python and TypeScript SDKs
tooling: Python and TypeScript SDKs, and raw HTTP and WebSocket calls with the API key from the dashboard; every model id is set in the speech_models field of the request
chaining: the credit pays for batch transcription of recorded audio, which a free CI runner can post file by file; pair it with a free object store for the audio, since the credit covers the API and nothing else. The 5 new streams per minute cap makes live capture on the free tier a poor fit.

limits.value: USD 50 in free credits at signup, one-time; the pre-recorded rate is USD 0.15 per hour on Universal-2 and USD 0.21 per hour on Universal-3.5 Pro
free-tier streaming concurrency is 5 new streams per minute against 100 new streams per minute on pay-as-you-go

binding_note: the one-time USD 50 credit is the ceiling for batch work; the 5 new streams per minute cap is a second, separate wall for streaming

identity_cost.detail: no credit card at signup ('no credit card required'); the signup page offers Continue with Google or Continue with email behind a reCAPTCHA check; unverified: whether a phone number or an email confirmation step follows the form

reliability_note: streaming is billed on session duration, not audio duration, so an idle open connection spends credit; the default model can differ between free-tier and paid accounts, so speech_models should be set explicitly
confidence_note: the credit, the card-free signup, the rates and the free-tier streaming cap are quoted from the vendor pricing page; the credit's expiry and its scope over the LLM gateway and text-to-speech were not stated and are unverified.
